The wooden handles of the plow appear to blend slightly into the dark mass of the horse's rear/tail area. The boundary is soft and indistinct, suggesting a generation error where two objects fused.

The long wooden beam connecting the horse to the plow share seems to float slightly above the ground in the middle section before diving down, defying rigid physical geometry. It lacks a clear support structure touching the earth.
